Class AbstractTransactionStatus

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.transaction.support.AbstractTransactionStatus
All Implemented Interfaces:
Flushable, SavepointManager, TransactionExecution, TransactionStatus
Direct Known Subclasses:
DefaultTransactionStatus, SimpleTransactionStatus
public abstract class AbstractTransactionStatus extends Object implements TransactionStatus
Abstract base implementation of the TransactionStatus interface.

预实现了对本地回滚标记和完成标志的处理，以及委托给底层 SavepointManager 接口。此外，还提供了在事务中保存检查点（savepoint）的选项。

不假设任何特定的内部事务处理，例如底层事务对象，且无事务同步机制。

Since:
1.2.3
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

    • setRollbackOnly

      public void setRollbackOnly()
      描述从接口复制：TransactionExecution
      Set the transaction rollback-only. This instructs the transaction manager that the only possible outcome of the transaction may be a rollback, as alternative to throwing an exception which would in turn trigger a rollback.

      默认实现抛出 UnsupportedOperationException。

      Specified by:
      `setRollbackOnly` 在接口 `TransactionExecution` 中
      See Also:
      • TransactionExecution.isRollbackOnly()

    • hasSavepoint

      public boolean hasSavepoint()
      描述从接口复制：TransactionStatus
      Return whether this transaction internally carries a savepoint, that is, has been created as nested transaction based on a savepoint.

      此方法主要用于诊断目的，与TransactionExecution.isNewTransaction()一起使用。对于自定义保存点的程序化处理，请使用SavepointManager提供的操作。

      默认实现返回false。

      Specified by:
      `hasSavepoint` 接口 `TransactionStatus` 中
      See Also:
      • TransactionExecution.isNewTransaction()
      • SavepointManager.createSavepoint()
      • SavepointManager.rollbackToSavepoint(Object)
      • SavepointManager.releaseSavepoint(Object)
